newsitem.title: LATVIA: VALMIERA Q1 PROFIT OVER 200,000 LATS.
newsitem.headline: VALMIERA Q1 PROFIT OVER 200,000 LATS.

text.p: Latvia's Valmiera Glassfibre company said on Thursday that its first quarter preliminary profit was more than 200,000 lats, fall against the figure of 600,000 lats during the same period of 1996.
The company had turned over of 2.54 million lats during the first three months against 2.71 million lats in the first quarter of last year.
"One of the main reasons behind the difference in these two figures is the fall of the mark as more than 50 percent of our market is in Germany," Dzintar Rudzitis, chief accountant, told Reuters.
He said that the mark fell at the end of last year from 0.37 lats to 0.34 lats, which meant that losses were made both on conversion and from the fall in the mark.
The company posted a total 1996 profit of 165,000 lats on turnover of 9.6 million lats.
"We hope to be ready with the finalised first quarter results for our shareholders' meeting," Imant Saulitis, finance manager, told Reuters.

"This quarter we have to work with two balance sheets as the privatisation agency approved an increase of our basic capital to 11.5 million lats from March 1 against 4.2 million lats before," Saulitis added.
The agency earlier capitalised and wrote off Valmiera's tax debts, boosting its share capital.
The company's shareholder meeting is scheduled for Aril 19.
